title: Allow choosing on and off values to the toggle

comments.body:
> WDYT?

yes I was unsure also about the on/off**Value** thing. Maybe it makes more sense what you wrote.
:+1: I really like it, but would love to have the input of @pixelastic and @kokliKo on this one too.

What happens on first load with:

``` javascript
values: {
  on: 'banana',
  off: 'orange'
}
```

Will it be in an undefined state or directly set to `orange`? I would set it to `orange`
I feel it should be an option and forcing the user to provide the default value (explicit), maybe `defaultValue`?
I would go for a default to the `offValue` if provided, and add an optional `defaultState: ['on', 'off', null/undefined]`.
